qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Owns Cruachan pumped-storage hydro and large-scale biomass generation units, but lacks pricing power due to wholesale electricity price-taker status and heavy dependence on government biomass subsidies (ROC cliff in 2027).
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (REJECT). UK power generator operates as a wholesale commodity price taker whose margins depend on power/gas/pellet spreads and government subsidy schemes. Lucrative legacy ROC biomass subsidies expire in 2027, transitioning to a lower-margin dispatchable CfD bridge.
qualitative.evidence: Core biomass generation at Drax Power Station is exposed to global wood pellet supply costs, shipping freight, and UK wholesale power prices. Expiration of ROC subsidies in March 2027 marks a sharp reduction in subsidy yields. Operating margins and ROIC fluctuate with merchant spark spreads and government policy rather than autonomous pricing power.
